annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Apply forwarded CLI args to the running editor (layout / screen / preview / create-new / scrolling-template / new-template). Conflicting shapes are resolved by the running instance with the CLI parser's precedence (new-template, then templateId, then createNew, then layoutId) rather than rejected — this method has no reply to carry a refusal. Does not raise the window.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Effective screen ID to open on (virtual-screen aware). Empty = keep current.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Layout UUID or autotile: prefix to load. Empty = keep current. Callers must not combine with templateId/newTemplate (the template shape wins).

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Create a new layout instead of loading one. Mutually exclusive with layoutId, and with templateId/newTemplate (the template shape wins).

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Open in read-only preview mode. Auto-enabled for autotile: layoutIds.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Scrolling template UUID to edit. Empty = not a template launch. Mutually exclusive with layoutId/createNew.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Create a new scrolling template. Mutually exclusive with templateId and the layout shapes.
